name: Freedom
fix_description: Add onlyOwner or access control modifier to buyToken (func_0287/0x057466ea). Currently anyone can call it to swap tokens using the contract funds without authorization.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short, direct flash-loan-assisted exploit with only a few steps: borrow WBNB, swap to FREE, call the vulnerable buyToken with a manipulated parameter, swap back, and repay. It does not require deep protocol internals or complex cross-contract state reasoning, and an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it quickly after identifying the flawed buyToken logic.
